description: Complete guide to Khabarovsk, Khabarovsk Krai: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Khabarovsk is a city in Khabarovsk Krai with a population of 610,000. A major Far Eastern city on the Amur River, the administrative center of the Russian Far East with a strategic location near China. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 3b growing zone supports Cold — cold-hardy vegetables, some perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
